data.name: Alex
data.gender_notes: Alex is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Alexandros', meaning 'defender of the people'. In Greek mythology, Alexander the Great was a powerful conqueror, and his name became synonymous with strength and leadership. In Christian tradition, Alex is a name for boys meaning 'protector' or 'defender'. The name Alex carries the meaning “Defender of people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Alex usually hope their child will grow to embody defender of people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of protection and strength
data.etymology: Alex belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Defender of people.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alex total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: אלכס
in_hebrew.meaning: אלכס משמעותו מגן האנושי או מגן האל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלכס הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'מגן האנושי' או 'מגן האל'. השם אלכסנדרוס (Αλέξανδρος) מורכב מ'אלקס' (אלכס) שמשמעותו 'מגן' ומ'אנדרוס' שמשמעותו 'אנושי' או 'אל'. השם אלכס הוא קיצור של אלכסנדרוס ומשמש כשם עצמאי.

in_greek.name: Αλέξ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αλέξ είναι σύντομη μορφή του Αλέξανδρος (Aléxandros), που σημαίνει 'υπερασπιστής' ή 'αμυνόμενος'. Στην αρχαία Ελλάδα, το όνομα Αλέξανδρος ήταν πολύ δημοφιλές και συνδέθηκε με τον μεγάλο βασιλιά Αλέξανδρο τον Μέγα. Το όνομα Αλέξ διατηρεί την ίδια πνευματική σημασία, συμβολίζοντας προστασία και δύναμη.

in_latin.name: Alex
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Alex is derived from the Greek name Aléxandros (Αλέξανδρος), meaning 'defender' or 'protector'. This name was popularized by Alexander the Great, a king of ancient Greece. In Christian tradition, the name Alex symbolizes strength and protection, reflecting its etymological roots.

in_english.name: Alex
in_english.meaning: Defender of the people or protector
in_english.long_meaning: The name Alex originates from the Greek name Alexandros (Αλέξανδρος), meaning 'defender of the people' or 'protector'. It is a shortened form of Alexander, which was popularized by Alexander the Great. In Christian tradition, Alex symbolizes strength, courage, and protection. The name has been widely used across various cultures and is associated with leadership and resilience.

data.cultural_impact: In many Western cultures, the name Alex is frequently used, having been a popular name throughout history. Its association with strength, leadership, and protection imparts a sense of courage and resilience.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, Alex represents a reminder of God's protection and defense for His people. As a defender of the faith, the name evokes a sense of dedication, commitment, and strength in the face of challenges. Additionally, the name can inspire individuals to be protectors of their communities, families, and personal values.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Alexander means "defender of the people" in Greek. In the Christian context, the name Alex can symbolize standing up for one's faith and beliefs, or being a protector and provider for one's loved ones. It can also spiritually represent the inner strength and courage we draw from our connection with God.
